messages:
ashley: FinOps sent a billing alert — ~1.2TB inter-region egress charged on the Mar 11 invoice, mostly eu-west1 -> us-central1. Invoice: https://billing.internal/redwood/INV-2026-0311. Anyone seen mass artifact transfers around 03:00-04:00 UTC?

infra-bot: [automated] Billing anomaly detected for project `redwood-prod` — inter-region egress spike from eu-west1. Alert: billing-20260311-02

mike: I was paged by monitoring: checkpoint-mirror job count spiked in eu-west1 at 03:06 UTC. The sync workers started retrying failed jobs.

sara: pulling kube logs from cluster-eu-west1, sanitised tail below:
```
2026-03-11T03:05:58Z checkpoint-sync [info] reconcile started batch_id=20260311-03
2026-03-11T03:06:02Z checkpoint-sync [error] mount to nfs://internal-store timed out after 12s
2026-03-11T03:06:03Z checkpoint-sync [warn] internal endpoint unavailable, using external object endpoint
2026-03-11T03:07:15Z checkpoint-sync [info] upload start -> https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-model-checkpoints-us/batch-20260311-03/part-0001
2026-03-11T03:09:43Z checkpoint-sync [info] upload complete bytes=563200000000 duration=2m28s
```
Looks like when the NFS mount failed it fell back to public S3 and started large uploads.

jin: That matches an alert I saw on the NFS server — kernel OOM killed the mount helper around 03:04. Storage team said the NFS node is under investigation.

ashley: Do we have config that allows public fallback? It should prefer provider peering. Where's the config?

mike: Found the helm values used for that deployment in prod: `sync.force_public_fallback: true` under the eu-west1 overlay. There was a last-minute change in Helm release `sync-chart@1.8.2` by me for a canary test on Mar 10. I forgot to flip it back. Full diff: `+force_public_fallback: true`

sara: oh — that explains it. When `force_public_fallback` is true the code skips internal transfer methods and uses the configured object endpoint (public).

alex: FinOps says ~1.2TB billed as "public internet egress" at $0.095/GB => ~\$114 for that window, but there are other smaller lines making the total ~\$1.1k for the month. I'll open a dispute but we need solid RCA.

ashley: Immediate actions:
- scale the checkpoint-sync deployment replicas -> 0 in eu-west1 to stop further public transfers
- roll back the Helm override and redeploy with `force_public_fallback: false`
- coordinate with storage to re-run the mirror using provider internal transfer (no public egress)
- FinOps to file billing case with provider and attach logs/config diff

mike: scaling down now: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy checkpoint-sync --replicas=0 --context=cluster-eu-west1` ✅

sara: submitting PR to revert the chart override and adding a validation that disallows `force_public_fallback: true` for prod clusters. Also adding a CI lint that rejects public-fallback in overlays/production.

storage-bot: [automated] Storage ops notified. Creating bucket copy job using internal provider replication token. Job id: storage-copy-20260311-01

jin: We'll also investigate the NFS OOM root cause. If the mount helper is flaky we should hard-fail sync jobs instead of auto-falling back. Patch incoming: make `retry_on_mount_failure` false in prod and surface a PagerDuty if mount fails.

alex: Opening billing dispute now (case: CB-20260311-87). I'll attach the logs, helm diff, and the incident timeline. If provider grants credit we'll adjust cost allocation.

ashley: Good. Follow-ups: add dashboard panels to split egress by destination (internal peering vs public) per service, create alert for >100GB/hour public egress from any single service, and update runbook to include a manual guard when toggling fallback flags.

infra-bot: [automated] Incident recorded: INC-2026-0311-checkpoint-public-egress. Assigned to eng-infra.

mike: PR opened -> revert + CI guard, link: https://git.internal/redwood/sync-chart/pulls/128

sara: Confirmed scaled pods terminated; no additional public uploads detected after 03:20 UTC. Storage copy started and will re-run mirror without public egress.

alex: Will update when cloud billing replies. Tagging for follow-ups: @mike @sara @jin. :warning:

ashley: Thanks everyone. Please add this incident to next week’s cost review deck. Closing thread when billing dispute updates and PR merged.
